templates.name: Activated Partial Thromboplastin Time (aPTT)
templates.instructions: Citrate tube; mix gently and send immediately.

templates.name: Blood Group and Rhesus (Rh) Type
templates.instructions: No fasting required. Bring a previous blood group card if available.

templates.name: Complete Blood Count (CBC)
templates.instructions: Collect EDTA whole blood. Mix thoroughly before analysis.

templates.name: Erythrocyte Sedimentation Rate (ESR)
templates.description: Sedimentation rate as a marker of inflammation
templates.instructions: Collect in sodium citrate tube and analyse within 4 hours.

templates.name: Hemoglobin Genotype (Hb Electrophoresis)
templates.description: Screening for sickle cell trait and disease
templates.instructions: EDTA whole blood. Avoid transfusion within 3 months of testing.

templates.name: Iron Studies (Serum Iron, TIBC, Ferritin)
templates.instructions: Fasting morning sample; iron supplements stop 24 hours before.

templates.name: Prothrombin Time / INR (PT-INR)
templates.description: Extrinsic coagulation pathway and warfarin monitoring
templates.instructions: For patients on warfarin, report the therapeutic range with the INR.

templates.name: Vitamin B12 and Folate
templates.instructions: Fasting sample preferred; protect from light.

templates.name: Vitamin D (25-Hydroxy)
templates.instructions: No fasting required.

templates.name: COVID-19 Rapid Test
templates.instructions: Collect nasal swab sample. Test according to manufacturer instructions.

templates.name: Dengue NS1 Antigen and IgM/IgG
templates.instructions: NS1 is most useful within the first 5 days of fever.

templates.name: Helicobacter pylori Stool Antigen
templates.description: Active H. pylori infection without endoscopy
templates.instructions: Stop proton pump inhibitors 2 weeks and antibiotics 4 weeks before.

templates.name: Hepatitis B Surface Antigen (HBsAg)
templates.instructions: No fasting required.

templates.name: Hepatitis C Antibody (Anti-HCV)
templates.instructions: A reactive screen needs confirmatory HCV RNA testing.

templates.name: HIV 1/2 Screening
templates.instructions: Counselling and consent required before sampling.

templates.name: Malaria Test
templates.instructions: Collect capillary blood. Test within 24 hours of collection.

templates.name: Sputum AFB Microscopy (GeneXpert)
templates.instructions: Early morning deep-cough sputum; two samples increase sensitivity.

templates.name: Syphilis Serology (RPR/VDRL)
templates.instructions: A reactive screen needs confirmatory TPHA/TP-PA.

templates.name: Typhoid Test (Widal)
templates.description: Salmonella typhi O and H antibodies
templates.instructions: Blood culture is more reliable after the first week of fever.

templates.name: Blood Glucose
templates.description: Fasting or random blood glucose test
templates.instructions: For fasting blood sugar, patient should fast for 8-12 hours.

templates.name: C-Reactive Protein (CRP)
templates.instructions: No fasting required.

templates.name: Cardiac Markers (Troponin I and CK-MB)
templates.description: Chest pain and myocardial injury panel
templates.instructions: Emergency sample: send to the laboratory immediately after collection.

templates.name: Glycated Hemoglobin (HbA1c)
templates.description: Three-month average blood glucose for diabetes control
templates.instructions: No fasting required. Values above 6.5% suggest diabetes.

templates.name: Lipid Profile
templates.instructions: Patient must fast for 12 hours before sample collection.

templates.name: Liver Function Test (LFT)
templates.instructions: Collect fasting sample. Avoid alcohol for 24 hours before test.

templates.name: Microalbuminuria (Urine Albumin-Creatinine Ratio)
templates.description: Early kidney damage in diabetes and hypertension
templates.instructions: First morning mid-stream urine.

templates.name: Pancreatic Enzymes (Amylase and Lipase)
templates.description: Acute pancreatitis and abdominal pain work-up
templates.instructions: Fasting sample; alcohol avoided for 24 hours.

templates.name: Renal Function Test
templates.instructions: Patient should be well hydrated before sample collection.

templates.name: Serum Calcium and Phosphate
templates.description: Bone, parathyroid and kidney mineral panel
templates.instructions: Fasting morning sample.

templates.name: Serum Electrolytes (Na, K, Cl, CO2)
templates.instructions: Avoid tourniquet stasis; separate serum within 1 hour.

templates.name: Serum Uric Acid
templates.instructions: Fasting sample; alcohol and diuretics raise the result.

templates.name: Total Protein, Albumin and Globulin
templates.description: Nutritional, liver and kidney protein panel
templates.instructions: No fasting required.

templates.name: Urinalysis
templates.instructions: Collect midstream urine sample in sterile container.

templates.name: 8am Cortisol
templates.description: Adrenal function, Cushing and Addison screening
templates.instructions: Collect before 9 am; stress raises the result.

templates.name: Prostate Specific Antigen (PSA)
templates.instructions: No ejaculation or prostate exam for 48 hours before testing.

templates.name: Serum Testosterone (Total)
templates.instructions: Morning sample between 7 and 10 am.

templates.name: Thyroid Function Test (TFT)
templates.instructions: No special preparation required. Inform patient of any interfering medications.

templates.name: Pap Smear (Cervical Cytology)
templates.description: Cervical cancer screening with Bethesda reporting
templates.instructions: Avoid intercourse, douching and vaginal medications for 48 hours; not during menstruation.

templates.name: Pregnancy Test
templates.instructions: Collect first morning urine sample for best results.

templates.name: Semen Analysis
templates.instructions: 2-5 days abstinence before collection; keep the sample warm and deliver within 1 hour.

templates.name: Serum β-hCG Quantitative
templates.description: Pregnancy dating, ectopic and tumour marker
templates.instructions: Repeat sampling 48 hours apart is used to assess viability.

templates.name: Urine Pregnancy Test (β-hCG)
templates.instructions: First morning urine gives the most concentrated sample.

templates.name: Blood Culture and Sensitivity
templates.description: Septicaemia and fever of unknown origin work-up
templates.instructions: Two sets from separate sites before antibiotics.

templates.name: High Vaginal Swab (HVS) Culture
templates.instructions: No intercourse or vaginal products for 24 hours before sampling.

templates.name: Stool Analysis (Microscopy and Parasites)
templates.description: Ova, cysts, parasites and occult blood
templates.instructions: Fresh sample; avoid contamination with water or urine.

templates.name: Stool Culture and Sensitivity
templates.instructions: Fresh sample in a clean container; deliver within 2 hours.

templates.name: Urine Culture and Sensitivity
templates.instructions: Mid-stream urine before any antibiotic dose; report within 48 hours.

templates.name: Ambulatory Blood Pressure Monitoring (24h ABPM)
templates.description: White-coat and masked hypertension, nocturnal dipping
templates.instructions: Keep the cuff still and lower the arm when the machine inflates; note activities in the diary.

templates.name: Echocardiography (2D with Doppler)
templates.description: Cardiac structure, valve function and ejection fraction
templates.instructions: No fasting; bring blood pressure readings and any previous ECG.

templates.name: Electrocardiogram (ECG - Resting 12-Lead)
templates.description: Heart rhythm, ischaemia and conduction defects
templates.instructions: Avoid caffeine and heavy exercise beforehand; lie still and breathe normally.

templates.name: Treadmill Exercise Stress Test (ETT)
templates.instructions: No caffeine or heavy meal for 3 hours; wear walking shoes and comfortable clothing.

templates.name: Ultrasound - Abdomen and Pelvis
templates.description: Liver, gall bladder, pancreas, spleen, kidneys and pelvic organs
templates.instructions: Fast for 8 hours; drink water and do not empty the bladder for the pelvic view.

templates.name: Ultrasound - Breast
templates.description: Breast lump evaluation, often with mammography
templates.instructions: No lotion or deodorant on the chest wall on the day of the scan.

templates.name: Ultrasound - Kidney, Ureter and Bladder (KUB)
templates.description: Urinary tract stones, obstruction and prostate size
templates.instructions: Full bladder required; do not urinate before the scan.

templates.name: Ultrasound - Obstetric (Dating and Anomaly)
templates.description: Fetal viability, dating, growth and anatomy survey
templates.instructions: Bring the antenatal card; a full bladder is needed before 20 weeks.

templates.name: Ultrasound - Thyroid and Neck
templates.description: Thyroid, parathyroid and cervical lymph nodes
templates.instructions: No preparation needed; bring previous reports or biopsies.

templates.name: Ultrasound - Transvaginal
templates.instructions: Empty the bladder before the scan. Cycle day noted for fertility scans.

templates.name: Bone Mineral Densitometry (DEXA Scan)
templates.description: Osteoporosis screening with hip and spine T-scores
templates.instructions: Avoid calcium supplements for 24 hours and wear clothing without metal.

templates.name: CT Scan - Chest, Abdomen and Pelvis (Contrast)
templates.description: Staging, masses and complex abdominal disease
templates.instructions: Fast 4 hours before; bring recent creatinine result and report iodine allergies.

templates.name: CT Scan - Head (Non-Contrast)
templates.description: Stroke, head injury and intracranial bleeding
templates.instructions: Remove metal objects. Renal function needed before contrast studies.

templates.name: Mammography (Bilateral)
templates.description: Breast cancer screening with BI-RADS reporting
templates.instructions: Best performed 7-14 days after the start of the last period; no deodorant or powder.

templates.name: MRI - Brain
templates.description: Demyelination, tumours, epilepsy and stroke work-up
templates.instructions: Metal implants, pacemakers and cochlear devices must be declared before scanning.

templates.name: MRI - Lumbar Spine
templates.description: Disc herniation, cord and nerve root compression
templates.instructions: Declare any metal implant or aneurysm clip; remove all metal items.

templates.name: X-Ray - Abdomen (Erect and Supine)
templates.description: Bowel obstruction, free air and urinary calculi
templates.instructions: Inform the staff if pregnant or possibly pregnant.

templates.name: X-Ray - Chest (PA View)
templates.description: Lungs, heart size, mediastinum and ribs
templates.instructions: Remove necklaces and metal clothing; inform the staff if pregnant.

templates.name: X-Ray - Extremity (Hand, Wrist, Foot or Ankle)
templates.instructions: Jewellery and dressings removed from the part being imaged.

templates.name: X-Ray - Lumbar Spine
templates.description: Back pain, disc space and vertebody alignment
templates.instructions: Two views (AP and lateral); metal clothing removed.

templates.name: Electroencephalogram (EEG)
templates.instructions: Clean, dry hair with no oil or extensions; sleep-deprived study if requested.

templates.name: Nerve Conduction Velocity and EMG (NCV/EMG)
templates.instructions: No lotion on the limbs; inform the staff of blood thinners before needle EMG.

templates.name: Spirometry (Pulmonary Function Test)
templates.instructions: No smoking or vigorous exercise for an hour; bring inhalers to the appointment.

templates.name: Histopathology (Biopsy Report)
templates.instructions: Biopsy must be placed in 10% formalin immediately and labelled with the site.
